d: El Salvador's President, Nayib Bukele, is promoting his country's healthcare system. Bukele is announcing that El Salvador has free, universal healthcare, and that this extends to foreigners, expats and tourists as well. Firstpost looks at El Salvador's medical system which promises free healthcare for all. Hem Kaur Saroya explains how Bukele expanded his country's public healthcare system using a digital project called DoctorSV. HKS also compares El Salvador's universal healthcare with the systems in countries like the US and the UK.
